note: Samples alignment (docs/design/samples-definition.md): a Matroska block that states more bytes than the file or its Cluster holds hands its cut frame to the codec parser flagged; the three Opus files with such a block gain lostSamples and the statistics node Lost Samples (the samples do not change). The Opus parser's sizes and bitrates (average, packet sizes, series) cover the packets the container hands over whole, so they change with the cut packet.
